description.value:
You channel a searing flash of light from your palm. Roll 6d10; this total is the pool of hit points the flash can affect. Every creature within a 15-foot cone from you that can see and is conscious is affected in order from lowest current hit points to highest.

Starting with the lowest-hit-point creature, each affected creature is blinded until the power ends, and its hit point total is subtracted from the remaining pool before moving to the next creature; a creature is affected only if its hit points do not exceed what remains in the pool.

Casting this power with a force slot of 2nd level or higher adds 2d10 to the initial roll for each slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 1
